name: 2plant (NVS-knot)
tagline: Two weeks of daily planting windows per 100 m of field: is there enough moisture to germinate, and is the ground safe for machinery?
problem: At planting, too little soil moisture kills germination and too much bogs down equipment; farmers rely on weather forecasts because field probes are costly and cannot forecast.
solution: A pre-planting soil moisture service that fuses SMAP/AMSR2 surface moisture, evapotranspiration and forecast ensembles through a reformulated exponential filter into root-zone estimates with propagated uncertainty. It scores moisture sufficiency and saturation risk at 15 cm and rates each day poor, fair, good or best for planting, with a 'second opinion' tab showing raw moisture and uncertainty.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won the award for the most potential to improve life on Earth or in the universe.
Assessed planting conditions from surface soil moisture and evapotranspiration data and built an app that lets farmers manage planting risks.
Reports accuracy against ground truth: about 0.03 m³/m³ root-zone error, close to calibrated probes, and 0.64 mm daily ET error against flux towers, with literature citations.
Built on an existing company's science and 2023–2024 farm pilots, answering requests from its customers; the MVP premiered at Space Apps.
Two plain questions, one timeline of planting windows, and published error bars: impact judges could see both the benefit and why to trust it.

lessons: Publish your error against ground truth; it answers the validity criterion before judges ask.
Reduce a hard model to two farmer questions and a four-level daily rating.
The team brought prior company work and pilots; check the current edition's rules on pre-event work before copying this.

sources.note: Team-written problem, method, accuracy figures with citations, pilot and pricing plans; AI used only for grammar and presentation cartoons.
